properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 4 at 3:48PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 348 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm near
Segundo, or 17 miles west of Trinidad, moving east at 45 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Trinidad, Cokedale, Starkville, Gulnare, Boncarbo, Segundo, and
Weston.
